segments.text:
5 And he appointed them prouiſion euery day of
the kynges meate and of hys wyne which hee dranke, ſo nouriſhyng them three yeares, that at the end therof, they might ſtand before the kyng.
6 Now among theſe were certaine of the children of Iuda, Daniel, Hananiah, Miſhael, and Azariah.
7 Vnto whom the chief of the Eunuches gaue other names. For he called Daniel Belteſhar, & Hananiah Shadrach, and Miſhael Meſhach, and Azariah Abednego.
